resources.string: A floating button for quick system shortcuts.
Shows a floating button with shortcuts like Home, Back, Recents, screenshot and lock screen. FloatMenu can\'t read what\'s on your screen and has no internet access.
FloatMenu is on. You can turn it off any time in Accessibility settings.
Turn on FloatMenu in Accessibility settings to get the floating button.
Landed on the main Accessibility page? Look under Installed apps. Switch greyed out (\"Restricted setting\")? Open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.

Only an Accessibility service can do the two things FloatMenu needs:

• Show the floating button on top of other apps, without the separate "display over other apps" permission.
• Press system buttons for you: Home, Back, Recents, notifications, quick panel, screenshot, lock screen and power menu.
• It can\'t read what\'s on your screen or what you type.\n• It has no internet access, so nothing ever leaves your phone.\n• No ads, no analytics. Only your settings are saved, on this phone.
